command:
ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIALS=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d'); printf 'SERIAL=%s
' "$SERIAL"; printf '%s
' '--- existing package metadata ---'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionCode=|versionName=|targetSdk=|firstInstallTime=|lastUpdateTime=|flags=|pkgFlags=' | head -30; printf '%s
' '--- package path ---'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path link.localclimate.app
